ai-tools-mastery.problemTitle: Everyone has AI. Almost nobody uses it well.
problemBody: Most people have opened ChatGPT, typed a question, gotten a mediocre answer, and moved on. Meanwhile, a small group is using these same tools to write in an hour what used to take a day, generate a week of content in an afternoon, and build automations that run while they sleep.
The difference isn’t access. It’s knowing which tool to use, how to prompt it, how to connect it to your real work, and how to catch it when it’s wrong.
That’s exactly what this course teaches.

faqs.question: Do I need any technical or coding background?
faqs.answer: No. The course is designed for non-technical professionals. The Week 3 app-building session uses AI coding tools driven entirely by natural language — you describe what you want, and the AI writes the code. Many learners with zero programming experience deploy a working app in that session.

faqs.question: I’ve already used ChatGPT quite a bit. Will this be too basic?
faqs.answer: If your experience is mostly typing questions into a chat box, no. Week 1 moves quickly past the basics into structured prompting, document workflows, and grounded research. Weeks 2–4 cover multimodal tools, automation, custom assistants, and app building — areas most casual users have never touched. If you’re already building automations and custom assistants, this course may be too introductory for you.

faqs.question: How much time will it take each week?
faqs.answer: Plan for about 6 hours of live sessions plus roughly 4 hours of practice and assignments — around 10 hours per week. Week 4 may run heavier as you finish your final project.

faqs.question: What if I can’t attend a live session?
faqs.answer: Every session is recorded and posted within 24 hours. Labs are designed so you can complete them from the recording, and you can ask questions in the community channel or at office hours. We recommend attending live whenever possible, since the hands-on help is the biggest benefit.

faqs.question: Which AI tools do I need to pay for?
faqs.answer: Most labs can be completed on free tiers. A paid plan for one chat assistant (Claude, ChatGPT, or Gemini — roughly ₹1,600–2,000/month) is strongly recommended because free tiers have usage limits that can interrupt labs. Beyond that, you’ll be able to try image, video, and automation tools on free or trial plans. Budget ₹3,500–5,000 for the month if you want paid access to everything.

faqs.question: Do I need a powerful computer?
faqs.answer: No. Everything runs in a web browser. Any laptop from the last several years with a stable internet connection is fine.

faqs.question: Will the tools be outdated by the time I take the course?
faqs.answer: The AI landscape moves fast, which is why the curriculum focuses on transferable skills — prompt structure, evaluation, workflow design — rather than memorizing menus. The specific tools are reviewed and updated before every cohort, and the skills you learn carry over when a tool changes or a new one appears.

faqs.question: Can I use AI tools safely with my company’s data?
faqs.answer: Week 4 covers this in depth: what to never paste into consumer AI tools, how enterprise tiers differ, and how to work within a company AI policy. For course labs, we provide sample datasets so you never need to use confidential material.

faqs.question: What is the final project, and do I have to do it?
faqs.answer: The final project is a working AI-powered solution you build, document, and present in Week 4. You choose the track — content pipeline, custom assistant, automation, app, or your own idea. It’s required for the certificate and is worth 45% of your grade. It’s also the part learners most often say was worth the entire course.

faqs.question: Is there a certificate?
faqs.answer: Yes. You receive a certificate of completion after passing (70% overall) and presenting your final project. It can be added to LinkedIn and your résumé.

faqs.question: Can I get this course for my team?
faqs.answer: Yes. We offer group rates for 3 or more learners and private cohorts for teams of 10+, where labs and the final project can be tailored to your company’s actual workflows. Contact us for details.

faqs.question: What’s the refund policy?
faqs.answer: Attend the first two sessions. If the course isn’t what you expected, email us before Session 3 and we’ll refund you in full. After Session 3, no refunds are issued, but you can transfer your seat to a future cohort once.

faqs.question: Is the course accessible for people with disabilities?
faqs.answer: Sessions include live captions, and all recordings include transcripts. If you have specific accommodation needs, please contact us before the cohort begins so we can support you.

faqs.question: I have a question that isn’t answered here.
faqs.answer: Email [support@yourdomain.com] or book a 15-minute call — we’re happy to help you decide whether the course is the right fit.
